name: Hunter Hearts
source:
Have you ever had that feeling, where at any moment later on something bad would happen? Maybe a low amount of courage or even death? Well, Hunter Hearts is all future based. Hunter Hearts is from the book the creator is writing at the moment. The game on the other hand is completely different compared to the book. Hunter Hearts is about a boy named Hunt and he is starting college at the age of 19. He meets a lot of girls and falls in love with a few of them, but who is the true lover of Hunt? Is it Riley, the other 19 year old girl that falls in love with him or is it Lisa, his childhood friend?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1312570/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是否有过这样的感觉：随时都会有不好的事情发生？也许是勇气不足甚至死亡？嗯，《猎人之心》是基于未来的。《猎人之心》取自创作者目前正在撰写的书籍。另一方面，游戏与书本完全不同。《猎人之心》讲述了一个名叫亨特的男孩，他19岁开始上大学。他遇到了很多女孩，并爱上了其中的一些女孩，但谁是亨特的真正爱人呢？是另一个爱上他的19岁女孩莱利，还是他儿时的朋友丽莎？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1312570/]Steam[/url]]
